title: Turkish Navy Commander in Alexandria for Sea of Friendship-2026; Kuwait's Air Chief in Türkiye
excerpt: Admiral Ercüment Tatlıoğlu attended the Türkiye-Egypt naval exercise hosted in Alexandria, while Kuwait's air force commander began a four-day visit to Türkiye.
rank_math_title: Sea of Friendship-2026: Turkish navy chief in Egypt
rank_math_description: Türkiye's navy commander attended the Sea of Friendship-2026 exercise hosted by Egypt in Alexandria; Kuwait's air force commander is visiting Türkiye until 14 November.
